what: Over a big photo pinned to the screen, ten (default 12) background-color vertical strips cover it at full screen height. Tied to scroll (scrub .8), each strip in turn shrinks from 100vh → 0 in height (.45, stagger total .2), opening the photo. From progress .24 the quote letters rise from 100% below, one by one (letter .05, stagger total .4), and at .83 the strips come back up from 100% below to cover the photo again (.47, stagger total .2). This runs from when the section head touches the bottom of the screen until the tail passes −40px above the top

options.close: If set to ”off”, the band does not cover it again at the end
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel (child) attached to the screen — holds photo and text. The strip is built inside it
options.[data-fx-part=text]: (If any) Quote to light up character by character

note: The original binds a single Webflow IX3 timeline (band shrink 0→.45 · text from .24 → · band re-expand .83→1.3) to scroll. The panel is sticky, so it doesn’t break inside an inner scroll panel either. The bands fit a grid 94% of the panel width (original main-container), and two thin bands cover the 3% at each end
